"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Many units have seen their operational requirements increased four-fold, wearing out both people and equipment.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Last fall, the Army certified two of its premier combat divisions as unready for war because of underfunding, mismanagement, and over-commitment to peacekeeping missions around the globe.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Soldiers must choose whether to stay with their families or to stay in the armed forces.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Sending the military on vague, aimless, and endless missions rapidly saps morale.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Back-to-back deployments, poor pay, shortages of spare parts and equipment, inadequate training, and rapidly declining readiness undermine morale.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The administration is not providing an adequate military health care system for active-duty service members and their families.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The administration is not providing an adequate military health care system for retired service members and their dependents.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The nation is failing to fulfill its ethical and legal health care obligations to those that are serving or have honorably served in the Armed Forces of the United States.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
